Your decision

You remain in control.

An initial evaluation does not guarantee enrollment. If a study may be appropriate, the team will explain informed consent and answer your questions before you decide. You may take the time you need, speak with someone you trust and decline participation. If you are already enrolled, you may withdraw at any time.
